replacements.new:
header_rows = list(kwargs["header"](ctx))
            self.assertIn(
                ("UFW Live Terminal v0.9.1", "c"),
                header_rows,
            )
            self.assertIn(
                ("Aktuální nativní UFW pravidla", "c"),
                header_rows,
            )
            self.assertIn(
                ("[ 1]", "22/tcp ALLOW IN Anywhere"),
                header_rows,
            )
            self.assertIn(":list", str(list(ctx.help())))
            self.assertEqual(
                kwargs["commands"]["list"].fn(ctx, ""),
                firewall_menu.TXT_FW_CONSOLE_LIST_REFRESHED,
            )
            return None

# Changelog

## v2.14.1

- UX Firewall Manager 0.9.1 přejmenovává položku menu na cyan `UFW Live Terminal` a konzole má vlastní horní hlavičku `UFW Live Terminal v...` s oddělenou sekcí aktuálních nativních pravidel.
- UX `:list` už neduplikuje pravidla do výsledkové části; dynamický header provede nový read-back a příkaz pouze potvrdí obnovení seznamu.

replacements.old: Status: **guarded manual UFW Apply implemented and cross-session ACK physically verified on dev-vm**; SysApps 2.14.0 / Firewall Manager 0.9.0 moves the native UFW console onto shared JBLibs 1.2.34 `terminal()` API.
replacements.new: Status: **guarded manual UFW Apply implemented and cross-session ACK physically verified on dev-vm**; SysApps 2.14.1 / Firewall Manager 0.9.1 uses the shared JBLibs 1.2.34 `terminal()` API and presents it as the cyan `UFW Live Terminal` with a versioned header and a separately rendered current-rule section.

replacements.old: Command results stay visible inside the terminal loop until the next input; do not reintroduce `anyKey` or a private input loop.
replacements.new: Command results stay visible inside the terminal loop until the next input; the dynamic header owns the authoritative current numbered-rule view, so `:list` refreshes that header instead of duplicating rules in the result area. Do not reintroduce `anyKey` or a private input loop.
